WHAT THEY NEED: One website-development set and one computer server delivered within 60 calendar days.

ELIGIBILITY:

  • A similar completed contract within five years valued at at least 50% of the PHP 2,000,000 ABC is required.
  • Bidding documents cost PHP 2,000 and manual bids are due October 28 at 10:00 AM PHT.
  • Bid security, separate technical and financial components, manufacturer/brand information, and product brochures are required.

BLOCKERS / RISKS:

  • Only eight days remain and submission is manual in Zamboanga City.
  • The PHP 1,000,000 similar-contract threshold may disqualify AIStaff without a qualified prime/JV partner.
  • The bundled physical server makes this partly a hardware-resale and onsite-delivery project.
  • The detailed website functions, hosting architecture, cybersecurity, migration, and support requirements are not stated in the abstract.

HOW WE COULD QUALIFY:

  • Partner with a Zamboanga-capable systems integrator that can satisfy the SLCC and server-supply requirements, with AIStaff delivering the website and integrations.

NEXT ACTION: Treat as partner-only: immediately review the free bidding package and proceed only if an eligible local integrator can satisfy the PHP 1,000,000 SLCC, server, bid-security, and manual-submission requirements.
